W.note: Very compact and restrained with a clean mobile layout, but on desktop the Add to bag label wraps to two lines and is clipped inside its 36px button, a visible defect on the primary view.

X.note: Feature-complete shop (search, filters, sort, stock badges, drawer with shipping and tax totals), but the 150px emoji tiles and tall cards are far from compact or minimal, and on mobile the Cart button is stranded under the brand instead of sitting with the search.

Y.note: Refined thin line-art and a restrained blue accent with a sticky Bag total and Checkout bar keep the shopping job clear; minor issues are a lone sixth card orphaned on desktop and a noisy Minimum 1 note that appears after adding.

Z.note: Strong feedback (In bag labels, toasts, drawer with qty and shipping hint, max-qty message), but the descriptions make cards tall, the letter-monogram tiles read as placeholders, and Add to bag buttons sit at uneven heights across each row.
